title: Samples Onramp / Launchpad Handoff Log — quick wins + blockers
content:
Meeting: Developer Experience — Samples Onramp Handoff
Date: 2026-07-28
Attendees: Evelyn (owner), Marco P., Aisha K., Noah K., Jess L. (PM sync), Tobi (SRE async)
Duration: 30m (standup + focused triage)
Format: quick status, unblockers, 2 decisions, action checklist

TL;DR
- Goal: finalize Launchpad handed-off sample bundle for GA beta (templates + quickstart + CI checks).
- Current blocker: flaky playwright tests in CI (browser sandboxing), and a dependency mismatch for node-sample-template (node 18 vs 20).
- Quick wins agreed: pin Node version in sample repo; add a lightweight smoke test to bypass flaky E2E for rollout; ship a trimmed launchpad with python/js templates + one guided notebook.

1) Status snapshot (by artifact)
- sample-repo/main (branch: launchpad-v1): overall green on unit tests, failing 6/24 playwright runs intermittently (timeout + headless chrome OOM).
  - Owner: Marco P.
  - Action: add PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS=1 memory tuning and increase timeout to 50s for flaky flows by 2026-08-02 (PR #482 open).

- quickstart-site (docs + embedded snippets): content ready, missing one image and a short video (30s) for the run-through.
  - Owner: Aisha K.
  - Action: produce the video using local capture + OBS; deliver to docs bucket by 2026-07-30; SDK snippet verification by 2026-07-31.

- python-sdk-sample: working, depends on new batching helper API (feature branch: batching-helper).
  - Owner: Evelyn W.
  - Blocker: internal API change needs review from runtime team (REQ: ensure KV cache config exposed).
  - Action: schedule 30m cross-team sync with serving-runtime for 2026-07-29.

- node-sample-template: fails on CI because official container uses Node 20 but CI runner is Node 18 -> build error for es-module imports.
  - Owner: Noah K.
  - Decision: pin container to node:20 for launchpad images and add .nvmrc to repo; fallback build step to transpile for Node 18 compatibility if needed.

2) Blockers / Risks
- Playwright flakiness: likely SRE sandbox limits + recent chromium upgrade. Risk: blocks GA if E2E gating is strict. Mitigation: add smoke check and mark flaky tests with @flake in test matrix; run flaky suite on scheduled nightly instead of pre-merge gating.
- Runtime API dependency (KV cache visibility): if serving-runtime can't expose the param in v1, we must ship sample with a note and feature flag. That will degrade recommended best-practices docs but unblock launch.
- Licensing: one of the third-party NPM libs used for the UI quickstart has a CLA-style restriction. Legal review requested (linked ENGDX-2147).

3) Decisions made
- Ship trimmed Launchpad GA (beta) without the full E2E gating: require unit tests + smoke test green; run full E2E nightly. (Decision: unanimous)
- Node runtime: standardize container images to Node 20 for all launchpad artifacts; add compatibility transpile step for legacy CI runners.

4) Action checklist (owners + dates)
- [Marco P] Increase playwright timeouts and add memory env flags, PR to fix flaky tests — due 2026-08-02.
- [Aisha K] Produce 30s run-through video, upload to docs bucket; inline snippet verification — due 2026-07-30.
- [Evelyn W] Cross-team sync with serving-runtime for KV cache API exposure — meeting 2026-07-29; create follow-up ticket if API not available.
- [Noah K] Add .nvmrc + container pin to node:20 and transpile fallback step — due 2026-07-29.
- [Jess L / PM] Update launch checklist and GA comms draft (one-pager) — due 2026-08-03.
- [Tobi / SRE] Validate CI runner memory limits and offer a temporary increase for playwright tasks — due 2026-07-30.

5) Notes to self / loose ideas (brainstorm fragments)
- Consider a tiny "playground" docker that pre-loads model weights for demo (local offline demo); useful for on-prem prospects.
- Short-term: embed a tiny latency dashboard into quickstart (client-side) to show token performance numbers; can be a static JSON for demo.
- Long-term: sample metrics integration plugin (Telemetry) that emits to Redwood Console sample namespace (metric names sketched: sample.launchpad.run_time_ms, sample.api_tokens_used).

6) Outstanding questions we didn't resolve
- Do we want the launchpad to include the Terraform snippet for Dedicated or leave infra examples in a separate repo? (Jess prefers separate; group leaning toward separate repo to keep surface area small.)
- If the serving-runtime team can't expose KV cache by v1, do we document a manual cache example? (tentative yes, but call it out as "advanced: optional").

7) Follow-ups for next standup (2026-08-04)
- CI flakes: progress report from Marco + SRE (Tobi).
- Batch helper API decision: update from Evelyn + runtime review notes.
- Launch checklist status: Jess to present updated comms and GA gating.

Appendix (quick links and snippets)
- PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/482 (playwright fixes), https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/490 (node pin + .nvmrc)
- Jira: ENGDx-2147 (legal/license check), ENGDx-2163 (playwright flaky tests), ENGDx-2180 (kv-cache runtime change request)
- Slack threads: #devexp-samples (pinned message: launchpad checklist), #ci-flakes (troubleshooting thread)

End of notes.

— Evelyn
(Notes captured after sync; will convert to tasks in Linear and update linked_artifacts afterwards)
